literal_meaning: গৃহিণী দ্বারা গৃহ মুক্ত বা বাসযোগ্য হয়
figurative_meaning_bn: গৃহিণী থাকলে তবেই গৃহ বাসযোগ্য হয়
figurative_meaning_en: A home becomes truly livable only in the presence of a housewife
similar_in_english: A house is not a home without a woman
Home is where the wife is
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়িটা যতই সুন্দর হোক না কেন, গৃহিণী না থাকলে গৃহমুচ্যতে না।
সে বিয়ের পর বুঝল যে গৃহিণী গৃহমুচ্যতে।
example_sentences_in_english: No matter how beautiful the house is, it doesn't become livable without a housewife.
After marriage, he realized that a home is made livable by the housewife.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali views on family structure and the central role of women in the home.
